test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

Father told Avika to stop watching the TV and eat her food.

options.text: Father said to Avika, "Stop eating the TV and watch your food."
Father said, "Avika, Why can't you stop watching the TV and eat your food?"
Father said, "Avika, stop watching the TV and eat her food."
Father said, "Avika, stop watching the TV and eat your food."

solution:
The correct answer is **"Father said, "Avika, stop watching the TV and eat your food."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of an indirect speech. 
 
• The given sentence is an example of an **imperative sentence. **
 
• The term "imperative sentence" refers to a sentence that expresses an **order, request, instruction, counsel, or warning**. The direct and indirect speech of these sentences also should convey the implied order, request, instruction, counsel, or warning.
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• He said, "Ram, go there." (Direct speech)
 
• He told Ram to go there. (Indirect speech)
 
 
 
 
 
• Rules to change these sentence
 
 
• That will get replaced with a comma. 
 
• **'Told'** will get replaced with** 'said'.**
 
• **'Her' **changes to **'your'.**
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: __*Father said, "Avika, stop watching the TV and eat your food."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Direct Speech: A direct speech report the precise words a speaker or writer used.
 
• Indirect Speech: Indirect speech focuses more on the content of what someone said rather than their exact words.
